title: SR ChestPreviwe Premium
description: SRChestPreviewer allows you to see the contents of any container without ever opening the UI. Perfect for survival
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/7hf8oVoV5DA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>The lightweight, no-config solution to peek inside containers!
​Ever get tired of opening every single chest just to find one item? SRChestPreviewer allows you to see the contents of any container without ever opening the UI. Perfect for survival, factions, or busy technical servers.
​✨ Key Features:
​Simple Peek: Just Sneak + Right-Click to see what's inside.
​Massive Compatibility: Works with Chests, Trapped Chests, Barrels, Furnaces, Blast Furnaces, and Smokers.
​Ultra Lightweight: Zero configuration needed. Plug and play. No database or heavy listeners.
​Cross-Platform Ready: Fully supports Geyser/Bedrock players. Perfect for Java-Bedrock hybrid servers.
​Performance First: Written in Java 21, optimized for 1.21.x (including 1.21.4 - 1.21.10).
​🛠 Supported Platforms:
​Paper / Spigot / Purpur
​Version: 1.21 and above (Tested on TL and official clients)
​Requirement: Java 21
​💬 Support & Community:
​Found a bug or have a suggestion? Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/AHDb4aQHhH
